name: superior-drummer-3
notes: Toontrack default (GM Extended) mapping as shipped with Superior Drummer — the same note numbers metalerator targets for SD3 (china 27/52, spock 29, ride bell 53, splash 55, crash 49/57, open hat 60, tight hat 63). Source: Toontrack default note map export (godprobe REAPER note maps, Metal Foundry default kit) cross-checked against metalerator/drums/common.py. Kits load articulations onto these notes by default; if you remapped SD3 (Settings > MIDI In/E-Drums), edit 'lanes'. Load the SD3 MIDI output on channel 10 or omni. SD3 has many velocity layers: keep velocities varied (humanize) and avoid flat 127s.
